questions.question: If N = (√7 - √5)/(√7 + √5), then what is the value of 1/N?
The sum of three consecutive even number is always divisible by ____.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let x be any even number 

then next two even numbers will be x + 2 and x + 4.

Now according to the question, 

⇒ x + x + 2 + x + 4 

⇒ 3x + 6

⇒ 3(x + 2)

Now we have 3 as common multiple,

We know that x is an even number, 

Hence from the above number,

⇒ (x + 2), we will also have 2 as a common multiple, 

⇒ 3 × 2 = 6

**∴ According to the question, it is divisible by 6. **

questions.question: How many positive factors of 24 are there?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Prime factorization of 24 = 2³ × 3¹

Total positive factors = (Power of 2 + 1) × (Power of 3 + 1)

⇒ (3 + 1) × (1 + 1)

⇒ 4 × 2 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The number is 24.

**Concept Used:**

The positive factors of a number are all the integers that divide the number completely without leaving a remainder.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let us list the pairs of positive integers whose product is 24.

⇒ 1 × 24 = 24

⇒ 2 × 12 = 24

⇒ 3 × 8 = 24

⇒ 4 × 6 = 24

⇒ The positive factors of 24 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, and 24.

⇒ Counting them gives exactly 8 factors.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Number of Factors

If a number N = pa × qb × rc (where p, q, r are prime factors), then the total number of factors = (a + 1)(b + 1)(c + 1).

Number of Odd Factors

To find odd factors, ignore the powers of 2. For N = 2a × pb × qc (where p, q are odd primes), odd factors = (b + 1)(c + 1).

Number of Even Factors

Subtract the number of odd factors from the total factors, or calculate directly using a × (b + 1)(c + 1).

Sum of Factors

For N = pa × qb, the sum of all factors is [(pa⁺¹ − 1) ÷ (p − 1)] × [(qb⁺¹ − 1) ÷ (q − 1)].

questions.question: 4/5 part of a tank is filled with oil. After taking out 42 litres of oil the tank is 3/4 part full. What is the capacity (in litres) of the tank?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Part of tank filled with oil = 4/5

Taking out quantity = 42 litres

New Part of tank filled with oil = 3/4

**CALCULATION:**

Let the capacity of the tank be x.

Given that,

4x/5 - 42 = 3x/4

4x/5 - 3x/4 = 42

x/20 = 42

x = 840 L

∴ Capacity of the tank is 840L

begin{array}{l} (1)/({20)} + (1)/({24)} - (1)/({{x)}} = (1)/({40)}\ (1)/(x) = (1)/({20)} + (1)/({24)} - (1)/({40)} = frac{{6 + 5 - 3}}{{120}} = (1)/({15)} end{array}

questions.question: P alone can complete the work in 5 days, Q alone can do same work in 6 days and R alone can do the same work in 12 days. They jointly complete the work and earn Rs 5400. What is the share of R?
questions.solution:
LCM of 5, 6 and 12 = 60

⇒ P can do 12 units of work in 1 day.

⇒ Q can do 10 units of work in 1 day.

⇒ R can do 5 units of work in 1 day.

Total earning will be divided in the ratio 12 : 10 : 5.

Let the ratio equal to k.

12k + 10k + 5k = 5400

k = 20

∴ Share of R = 5k = Rs. 1000

questions.question: The ratio of the speed of P, Q and R is 10 : 12 : 15 respectively. What is the ratio of the time taken by P, Q and R respectively to cover the same distance?
questions.solution:
For same distance,

Time is inversely proportional to velocity.

Ratio of time taken = 1/10 : 1/12 : 1/15 

LCM of 10, 12 and 15 = 60

The required ratio = 60 × 1/10 : 60 × 1/12 : 60 × 1/15

⇒ 6 ∶ 5 ∶ 4

∴ The required ratio is 6 ∶ 5 ∶ 4.

questions.question: Three bottles of equal capacity are containing a mixture of milk and water in ratio 2 : 1, 3 : 7 and 4 : 11 respectively. These three bottles are emptied into a large bottle. What is the ratio of milk and water respectively in this large bottle?
questions.solution:

Quantity of water in the final mixture = 1/3 + 7/10 + 11/15 = (10 + 21 + 22)/15 = 53/30

Ratio of milk and water in the final mixture = 37 : 53

questions.question: A person sold a book for Rs 21 and got a loss percentage which was numerically equal to the cost price. What is the cost price (in Rs) of the book?
questions.solution:
SP = Rs. 21

Given that, loss% = CP

Let CP = x

Loss% = (x - 21) ×100/x = x

x² = 100x - 2100

x² - 100x + 2100 = 0

x² - 70x - 30x + 2100 = 0

(x - 70)(x - 30) = 0

x = 70 or 30

questions.question: A bus starts running with some initial speed and its speed increases every hour by 9 km/hr. If it takes 11 hours to cover a distance of 572 km, then what was the initial speed (in km/hr) of the bus?
questions.solution:
Let the initial speed be x.

Total distance travelled in 11 hrs = x + (x + 9) + (x + 18) +……….+ (x + 90) = 572

11x + 9(1 + 2 + 3 +…….+10) = 572

11x + 9 × 10 × 11/2 = 572

11x + 495 = 572

11x = 77

x = 7

initial speed of the bus was 7 km/hr.

questions.question: A boat can cover 15 km upstream and 22 km downstream in 5 hours. It can cover 20 km upstream and 55/2 km downstream in 13/2 hours. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the stream?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of the boat and the stream be x and y respectively.

Speed of the boat downstream = x + y

Speed of the boat upstream = x - y

22/(x + y) + 15/(x - y) = 5 -----(i)

55/2(x + y) + 20/(x - y) = 13/2 -----(ii)

On solving eq(i) and eq(ii), we get

x + y = 11

and, x - y = 5

On solving, we get

y = 3

∴ Speed of the stream = 3 km/hr

questions.question: If a certain sum becomes 4 times in 4 years at compound interest, then in how many years, it will become 64 times?
questions.solution:
P(1 + r/100)⁴ = 4P

(1 + r/100)⁴ = 4

(1 + r/100) = (4)¹/⁴

Let after t years, amount will become 64 times of principle

P(1 + r/100)t = 64P

(1 + r/100)t = 64

(4)t/⁴ = 64 (4)t/⁴ = (4)³

t/4 = 3

t = 12 years.
